Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer hallucinated a specific burial location ("Chandler, Arizona" and "Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery") that was not present in the visible Wikipedia text, which only stated the place of death.
